snippet.title: Schooligans – Official Trailer | Trash the School With Your Friends (Up to 8 Players)
snippet.description:
Schooligans is a 1–8 player party game where the school can HEAR you 🎙️ Teachers react to your voice, students answer when you call their name. Just don't get caught.
👉 Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/5288780/?utm_source=youtube&utm_campaign=shorts
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

⏱️ CHAPTERS
0:00 Don't get caught!
0:09 Mini-games and up to 8 players
0:22 At night: sneak in and sabotage the class
0:40 The keys and video calls
0:53 Shop and casino
1:07 Vehicles and Schoolicards
1:28 Become a Schooligan: wishlist now

🎙️ THE SCHOOL IS LISTENING
Your microphone is part of the game. Talk too loud in class and the teacher hears you. Call a student by their name, compliment them, insult them: every teacher and every kid reacts to your real voice.

👥 UP TO 8 PLAYERS, ZERO DISCIPLINE
Open your phone, check your mission of the day, and cause chaos with up to 7 friends. Hit the teacher with a paper ball, slap your best friend, dab in front of the principal. Every dumb idea earns you Aura.

🌙 AT NIGHT: sneak back in and trash the class
💣 SABOTAGE: wreck tomorrow's class before it starts
🔑 THE KEYS: find them, steal the cheat sheets
📱 VIDEO CALLS: film the fails, call your squad
🛒 SHOP: gear up for mischief
🎰 CASINO: spin to boost your items' value
🏎️ VEHICLES: drive all over the school
🃏 SCHOOLICARDS: collect them all

Class is in session. Behave… or don't.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
